notes: Phones are optional: pick Standard, Zenless Zone Zero or No phones for each world (in the creator, in Settings, or in the phone's own Settings app).
Standard phones use Messages and Social; Zenless Zone Zero worlds use Knock Knock and Inter-Knot (Krampus, and any world set in New Eridu, picks this automatically).
Each character can have a phone or not (creator → Basics). Characters without one don't show in your contacts and never text, call or post.
Customize the phone: rename the apps, pick its color and wallpaper (or your own picture), and choose which apps show on the home screen.
